# Get-ZbxHousekeeping

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the server's housekeeping settings.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxHousekeeping [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxHousekeeping cmdlet reads the housekeeping settings with housekeeping.get: whether the housekeeper deletes old events, history, trends, sessions and audit records, and how long it keeps each. A global history or trends period overrides every item's own when its Global setting is true. It writes one ZabbixHousekeepingSettings object and needs a Super admin's connection.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Read how long history and trends are kept

```powershell
Get-ZbxHousekeeping | Select-Object HousekeepingHistoryGlobal, HousekeepingHistory, HousekeepingTrendsGlobal, HousekeepingTrends
```

A period is a time with a unit, such as 31d or 365d.

### Example 2: Read every setting

```powershell
Get-ZbxHousekeeping | Format-List
```

Format-List shows each setting on its own line.
